items.title: Lot #411 - William Plumb Collection: Lawrence Noble Original Small-Scale Bronze Yoda Statue
items.description: 8-inch bronze Yoda statue produced by Killian Enterprises in 1990 under license from the small Lawrence Noble sculpt, made for the 10th anniversary of The Empire Strikes Back; part of the edition of 50. From William Plumb's personal collection.
items.auction_date: uncertain - appears to be a Propstore 'Entertainment Memorabilia' live auction, possibly ~2023; exact date not confirmed (sold price/date details sit behind a Propstore login wall and the site could not be fetched directly)
items.notes: Distinct from Propstore Lot #450 (also Plumb Collection, 'Limited-Edition Lawrence Noble Bronze Yoda Statue Artist Proof'), which appears to be an artist-proof from a different, later commissioned run (6 artist proofs + 30 statues) and not explicitly tied to the 1990 Killian edition of 50 - excluded as not a clear match.
